Subject: Temporary trial support while PO clears (Gamma Health)

Hi Jordan,

Quick status from our side — thanks for the update about procurement. I know finance at Gamma Health is working the PO but that gap can interrupt your team’s evaluation momentum. To keep your engineers progressing, we can provision a limited, temporary top-up of trial credits while the purchase order moves through legal/finance.

Proposal (fast path):
- Temporary token top-up: 150k tokens (approx. 3 days of heavy usage / 7 days light usage)
- Validity: 10 calendar days from activation
- No billing will be processed until we have an executed PO — credits expire if the PO is not received by the validity date

If that works, I’ll get manager sign-off and the credits can be applied within the hour after final approval. Can you confirm: 1) expected PO approval date, and 2) any procurement or SOC 2 docs their legal team still needs from us? I’ve attached the quote and a one-page summary of what the temporary authorization looks like.

Thanks — want to avoid the demo going dark.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Hi Naomi — thanks for the quick note and for offering a workaround. A few clarifying items before we proceed:

1) Can you confirm whether the temporary credits will alter the final invoice once the PO is processed? We need to show accurate spend projections to our finance team.
2) Is there any contract change or amendment required for this temporary grant? Our legal team is strict about addenda.
3) Our current expected PO approval is the week of Aug 10, but that's still tentative — procurement has to validate a vendor security questionnaire.

If you can send a short authorization note (one page) and an explicit statement that the credits are for trial continuity only (non-billable until PO), I can push procurement to accept the temporary arrangement.

Appreciate the help — Jordan
Jordan Park
